description: Producer changed shared units/name without agreement; local tests pass but actual consumer integration fails.

files.docs/contracts.md:
# Agreed contract
The run producer emits elapsed_ms in milliseconds. The cost report converts it to seconds for display. Human acceptance: the integrated report displays the correct elapsed seconds for actual runs.
files.docs/progress.md:
# Delivery status
Producer and report were each marked locally verified. Overall integration is pending.
The producer now emits elapsed_seconds instead. This is an implementation change, not an approved contract revision.
files.docs/evidence.md:
# Evidence
Producer local test: passed for elapsed_seconds=2.
Report local test: passed with mocked elapsed_ms=2000, renders 2 seconds.
Actual integration: producer returned elapsed_seconds=2; report raised KeyError: elapsed_ms.
The report title rendering test is unchanged and passed.

request: 两个部分自己的测试都过了，能不能算整体完成？请结合现有记录分析哪里需要继续处理，哪些原有成果还能用，给出下一步建议。先不要改契约、代码或文件。
acceptance: Rejects overall completion, distinguishes contract change from approved intent, identifies affected consumer/design/checks and still-valid work, recommends repair or a supported decision without silently changing acceptance. No file changes.
